coaching.headline: Feeding Sparrow lost the game: fifteen kills, eleven on Mourn, TwinBlast and Steel, plus 38085 objective damage, the most of all ten players.

flags.text: Shit finish: after Steel's kill on Riktor, the enemy took all seven remaining kills plus Primal Fangtooth.
Took the enemy duo inhibitor yet never hit the enemy Core; six allied structures then fell, Core last.
Mourn and TwinBlast died eight times each, roughly double each hero's norm, seven of the sixteen to Sparrow.
Fangtooth went allied; Mourn, TwinBlast and Steel died around the take; allied offlane and duo outers fell.

focus.title: Fight Sparrow as a group, close as five
focus.action: Mourn and TwinBlast fight Sparrow only after Steel or Khaimera engages, and once an enemy inhibitor falls, all five group for Primal Fangtooth before any split.

21.5.call: The enemy took Fangtooth first, then Sparrow killed Steel, Mourn and Khaimera at the pit and TwinBlast on the duo lane. Once Fangtooth is gone, leave the pit.

29.call: Lost 1-4 in the allied half with TwinBlast falling first to Riktor, while the enemy duo inner fell to the allies; enemy Primal Fangtooth came soon after. Reset when the carry drops first.

34.2.call: Neon, Riktor and Sparrow killed TwinBlast, Mourn and Khaimera in the allied base and on the duo lane as all three allied inhibitors and the Core fell. Defend the last towers as five.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Six kills, three on Sparrow and two on Riktor, for 52% kill participation. When Sparrow drops low, commit Bull Rush or Shield Slam to finish the kill.
Four of five deaths went to Sparrow, two at the Fangtooth pit. Before the next pit fight, raise Force Shield between Sparrow and the backline first.
Fourteen wards beat an 11.8 norm, yet Riktor placed 23 and the enemy cleared 11 wards to the allied 3. Fill Sanctification's three-ward cap around Fangtooth before each spawn.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Hell of a hunt: nine kills, four on Sparrow plus first blood on Adele, and 15291 objective damage, the allied high. Keep hunting Sparrow whenever the duo lane fights.
Seven deaths on a norm near five, three to Sparrow, one at the Fangtooth pit and one in the allied base. Before entering a pit, ward the entrance first.
Orb Prime and the first Fangtooth both went to the enemy with no ally dead. On each spawn, call the team to contest or take an enemy tower in trade.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Eight deaths on a norm under four, three to Sparrow and two to Riktor. When Riktor is unseen, farm behind an ally so Riplash catches the frontline first.
454 hero damage per minute against an 837 norm, on 14.3k gold to Sparrow's 18.7k. When behind in gold, open trades on Sparrow with Vortex Grenade slows first.
Two deaths at the Fangtooth pit: to Riktor outside any detected fight, and to Adele as the allies took Fangtooth. Enter the pit only beside Steel.
8c5ead82-b2ae-494e-8939-67c855ff3866: Ran the vision: 29 wards, the most of all ten players, plus 9.2 CS per minute on a 7.2 norm. Keep that ward pace and farm rate every game.
The final death, to Neon on the mid lane outside any detected fight, came seconds before the allied mid inner fell. Late, with Neon unseen, hold mid beside an ally.
547 hero damage per minute against a 755 norm, with kills on Neon twice and Riktor once. When the duo lane fights, repeat the rotation that killed Riktor.
3a378a92-fcff-464c-b73a-0c09fabeb7e9: The game's first tower, the enemy offlane outer, plus 1271 hero damage per minute on a 1012 norm. Keep pressing the offlane, then call Khaimera before diving the inner.
Eight deaths, tied for the game's most, four to Sparrow; the first duo-lane death came just before the allied offlane outer fell. Rotate only after shoving the offlane wave.

matchup: Duo was TwinBlast and Steel against Sparrow and Riktor; allied duo deaths before minute ten ran two to four.
Riktor's Shock Therapy destroys enemy shields and silences, so Cybernetic Shell and Patina shields can be stripped.
build: Tainted Charm cuts healing by 45% for enemy heroes nearby, answering Adele's 29809 healing, the game's most.
Vainglory stacks armor on dealing or taking hero damage, and that armor feeds Heavy Metal's bonus damage.
Vainglory, finished last, missed the early fights.
eternal: Knell's Rust stacks shred enemy armors and return a share to Steel; Resonant Repair heals when immobilized.
Krix is the only Steel support Eternal with enough games, most played with no edge claimed; Knell is too thin to rank.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash equal to a share of total armors.
Heavy Metal is the only Steel support augment with enough games: most played, no edge claimed. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard shields Steel and nearby heroes and grants tenacity while the shield holds.
Sanctification and Rift Walkers are a toss-up for Steel support crests, with Sanctification on the better odds. Sound keep.
improvement: No item swap is proven by the recorded fights.
Testing Krix trades Knell's armor shred for bonus maximum health and size; Krix shows no proven edge.

matchup: Adele was the jungle opponent; Khaimera killed Adele three times, including first blood, and died to Adele once.
Adele's Imperial Lash and Queen's Garden root, and Royal Flourish mesmerizes.
build: Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing 45% for 3s on physical damage, into Adele's game-high healing.
Void Helm adds magical armor against Neon and Riktor and raises all healing taken by 20%.
Unbroken Will, finished last, raises both armors when immobilized; earlier fights ran without Unbroken Will.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after Ambush's leap.
Natural Resistance cleanses crowd control and grants tenacity at low health.
Thraex is the only Khaimera jungle Eternal with enough games, most played with no edge; Weald has too few games to rank.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion edges Feral Ambush on odds, but the Khaimera jungle augment field is a toss-up. Keep.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Iceskorn Talons is the only Khaimera jungle crest with enough games, most played with no edge; Judgement is too thin to rank.
improvement: Kit read: Iceskorn Talons trades Judgement's self-heal for an ice sheet giving allies power and speed and slowing enemies.
The item path shows no proven gap in the recorded fights.

matchup: Sparrow killed TwinBlast three times; TwinBlast killed Sparrow once, in the opening minutes.
Sparrow's Relentless deals target max-health damage on hits, and Viper shreds physical armor.
Riktor's Riplash pulls and Skewer suppresses; Riktor scored two TwinBlast deaths.
build: Solaris heals TwinBlast for half the empowered hit's damage after each ability cast.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below 5% health.
Imperator, finished last, raises critical damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Weald adds true-damage missiles against low-health heroes; Forage adds gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Among TwinBlast carry Eternals only Weald has enough games: most played, no edge shown.
No minor pair has enough games to rank; Forage with Wind-Rider is the most picked.
augment: Grenadier adds a Vortex Grenade charge, and Rocket Dash grants a charge on use.
Toss-up for TwinBlast carry augments: Grenadier leads Amplified Burst on odds. Sound keep as run.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger on targets below 20% max health.
Pacifier is the lone TwinBlast carry crest with enough games: most played, no edge shown; Liberator is too thin.
improvement: Kit read: a physical-armor item would blunt Sparrow's physical damage, giving up carry damage; no swap is proven.

matchup: Neon was the lane opponent: two Wraith kills on Neon, one Neon kill on Wraith, and Neon took the allied mid outer.
Neon finished with 21108 gold, the game's most.
build: Tainted Rounds cuts healing 45% for 3s on successful basic attacks, useful into Adele's healing.
Manta Scythe deals 8% more damage to targets with no nearby ally.
Viper, finished last, shreds physical armor; earlier fights ran without Viper.
eternal: Dryad's Boon trims basic ability cooldowns on basic hits, and Taproot heals on basic attacks.
The patch field has no Wraith sample, so no Eternal is ranked.
augment: Sniper's Bounty adds gold on Knock, Knock! killing blows, far more on heroes.
Kit read: three kills capped the Sniper's Bounty hero gold at three payouts.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device enters stasis briefly; Epoch evolves from Wizard Crest.
Without a Wraith field sample, Epoch stays a kit read.
improvement: Kit read: an earlier Viper would shred Sevarog's and Riktor's physical armor sooner; no swap is proven.

matchup: Sevarog was the lane opponent and never killed Mourn; Mourn killed Sevarog four times, yet Sevarog out-earned Mourn 18.3k to 13.5k.
Sevarog's Phantom Rush fears, and Subjugate chains enemies to the zone and slows.
build: Fire Blossom and Forticus add physical armor into Sparrow's four kills on Mourn.
No magical armor in the build against Neon and Riktor magical damage.
Raiment of Renewal, finished last, regenerates missing health each second; earlier fights ran without Raiment.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health; Regenerative Tissue regenerates out of hero damage, and Cannibalism adds health per takedown.
No Mourn offlane field cell exists on the current patch, so Krix is a kit read.
augment: Nightmare Extractor cuts Extract's cooldown whenever Mourn casts an ability.
Kit read: more Extract hits mean more cleave damage and healing in offlane brawls.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas grows size and max health briefly, damages nearby heroes, then adds permanent max health.
Saphir's Mantle evolves from Goliath Crest; no Mourn offlane field sample ranks crests.
improvement: Kit read: Void Helm or Unbroken Will in place of Overlord adds magical armor against Neon and Riktor, giving up cleave damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
ourKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate
